text_block_list.text: Summer camp season has come again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...Is it that time of year again?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: Be sure to take care of your health this time.

text_block_list.text:
Of course. I don't have time to collapse.
More
importantly...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
I'm different now than I was then. You're
different
than you were too.
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...I see. I understand about Biwa
Hayahide. I'll let
the president know.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's just you, Brian. You should know
better
than to sneak up on people...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You haven't heard even though she's
your sister?
She said she'll join us
partway through camp this
year.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
It has to do with her comprehensive
physical...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
...Just forget I said anything. If you
haven't heard,
it probably isn't that
important.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You should just concentrate on summer
camp. I'm
sure that's what your sister
wants.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Thus, our senior year summer camp
begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
